select p.id as programId, s.name as schoolName, s.province as province, s.city as city, s.tier as schoolTier, s.is_985 as is985, s.is_211 as is211, s.is_double_first as isDoubleFirst, c.name as collegeName, p.program_code as programCode, p.program_name as programName, p.research_direction as researchDirection, p.degree_type as degreeType, p.score_scale as scoreScale, p.protects_first_choice as protectsFirstChoice, p.is_joint_program as isJointProgram, subj.subject_codes as subjectCodes, subj.subject_names as subjectNames, as dataYear, sc.score_line as scoreLine, ap.total_plan as planCount, ap.unified_exam_quota as unifiedExamQuota, ap.retest_count as retestCount, ar.admitted_count as admittedCount, ar.min_admitted_score as admissionLow, ar.avg_admitted_score as avgAdmittedScore, ar.max_admitted_score as admissionHigh, as dataCompleteness, q.has_official_source as officialVerified, coalesce(preferred_ds.url, ar_ds.url, sc_ds.url, ap_ds.url) as sourceUrl, coalesce(preferred_ds.title, ar_ds.title, sc_ds.title, ap_ds.title) as sourceTitle, coalesce(preferred_ds.source_owner, ar_ds.source_owner, sc_ds.source_owner, ap_ds.source_owner, 'N诺') as sourceOwner, count(*) over (partition by s.id) as schoolTotal from program p join college c on p.college_id = c.id join school s on c.school_id = s.id left join ( select ps.program_id, group_concat(sub.code order by ps.subject_order separator ',') as subject_codes, group_concat(sub.name order by ps.subject_order separator ' + ') as subject_names from program_subject ps join subject sub on ps.subject_id = sub.id group by ps.program_id ) subj on subj.program_id = p.id
left join data_source sc_ds on sc_ds.id = sc.source_id left join data_source ap_ds on ap_ds.id = ap.source_id left join data_source ar_ds on ar_ds.id = ar.source_id where p.status = 'active' and s.status = 'active' and p.study_mode = 'full_time' and ( s.name like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or s.short_name like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or c.name like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or p.program_name like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or p.program_code like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') ) order by case when s.name = #{keyword} then 0 when s.name like concat(#{keyword}, '%') then 1 else 2 end, case when sc.score_line is null then 1 else 0 end, s.tier asc, p.id asc limit #{limit} offset #{offset}

select count(distinct p.id) from program p join college c on p.college_id = c.id join school s on c.school_id = s.id where p.status = 'active' and s.status = 'active' and p.study_mode = 'full_time' and ( s.name like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or s.short_name like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or c.name like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or p.program_name like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or p.program_code like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') )
